question: 戴尔 FY2025 第一季度的营收是多少亿美元？（保留两位小数）

tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql": "SELECT c.company_id, p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_quarter, f.value AS revenue_mn
FROM companies c
JOIN periods p ON c.company_id = p.company_id
JOIN facts f ON p.company_id = f.company_id AND p.fiscal_year = f.fiscal_year AND p.fiscal_quarter = f.fiscal_quarter
WHERE c.company_id = 'Dell'
AND p.fiscal_year = 2025
AND p.fiscal_quarter = 1
AND f.account_code = 'revenue'
AND f.version = 'original'"}

tool_calls.name: final_answer
tool_calls.arguments: {"answer_md": "戴尔 FY2025 第一季度（fiscal_year=2025, fiscal_quarter=1）营收为 22,244 百万美元，即 222.44 亿美元。", "claims": [{"text": "戴尔 FY2025 第一季度营收", "value": 222.44, "unit": "usd_100mn", "ref": "facts: Dell FY2025 Q1 revenue=22244 mn"}]}

answer_md: 戴尔 FY2025 第一季度（fiscal_year=2025, fiscal_quarter=1）营收为 22,244 百万美元，即 222.44 亿美元。
